pairs: When Jesus had said these things,
egressus est cum discipulis suis trans torrentem Cedron, ubi erat hortus,
he departed with his disciples across the Torrent of Kidron, where there was a garden,
in quem introivit ipse, et discipuli ejus.
into which he entered with his disciples.
quia frequenter Jesus convenerat illuc cum discipulis suis.
for Jesus had frequently met with his disciples there.
Judas ergo cum accepisset cohortem, et a pontificibus et pharisæis ministros,
Then Judas, when he had received a cohort from both the high priests and the attendants of the Pharisees,
venit illuc cum laternis, et facibus, et armis.
approached the place with lanterns and torches and weapons.
Jesus itaque sciens omnia quæ ventura erant super eum,
knowing all that was about to happen to him,
they moved back and fell to the ground.
“I told you that I am he.
permit these others to go away.”
This was so that the word might be fulfilled,
“Of those whom you have given to me,
I have not lost any of them.”
Simon ergo Petrus habens gladium eduxit eum:
Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it,
et percussit pontificis servum, et abscidit auriculam ejus dexteram.
and he struck the servant of the high priest, and he cut off his right ear.
Now the name of the servant was Malchus.
Calicem, quem dedit mihi Pater, non bibam illum?
Should I not drink the chalice which my Father has given to me?”
and the attendants of the Jews apprehended Jesus
Et adduxerunt eum ad Annam primum:
And they led him away, first to Annas,
for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas,
who was the high priest that year.
Erat autem Caiphas, qui consilium dederat Judæis: Quia expedit unum hominem mori pro populo.
Now Caiaphas was the one who had given counsel to the Jews that it was expedient for one man to die for the people.
Sequebatur autem Jesum Simon Petrus, et alius discipulus.
And Simon Peter was following Jesus with another disciple.
Discipulus autem ille erat notus pontifici,
And that disciple was known to the high priest,
et introivit cum Jesu in atrium pontificis.
and so he entered with Jesus into the court of the high priest.
Petrus autem stabat ad ostium foris.
But Peter was standing outside at the entrance.
who was known to the high priest,
et dixit ostiariæ: et introduxit Petrum.
went out and spoke to the woman who was the doorkeeper, and he led in Peter.
the woman servant keeping the door said to Peter,
et tu ex discipulis es hominis istius?
“Are you not also among the disciples of this man?”
Stabant autem servi et ministri ad prunas,
Now the servants and attendants were standing before burning coals,
erat autem cum eis et Petrus stans,
And Peter was standing with them also,
Pontifex ergo interrogavit Jesum de discipulis suis,
Then the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples
“I have spoken openly to the world.
I have always taught in the synagogue
et in occulto locutus sum nihil.
And I have said nothing in secret.
interroga eos qui audierunt quid locutus sim ipsis:
Question those who heard what I said to them. Behold,
ecce hi sciunt quæ dixerim ego.
they know these things that I have said.”
Then, when he had said this,
unus assistens ministrorum dedit alapam Jesu,
one of the attendants standing nearby struck Jesus, saying:
“Is this the way you answer the high priest?”
But if I have spoken correctly,
then why do you strike me?”
Et misit eum Annas ligatum ad Caipham pontificem.
And Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
Numquid et tu ex discipulis ejus es?
“Are you not also one of his disciples?”
Dicit ei unus ex servis pontificis, cognatus ejus, cujus abscidit Petrus auriculam:
One of the servants of the high priest (a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off) said to him,
Nonne ego te vidi in horto cum illo?
“Did I not see you in the garden with him?”
Adducunt ergo Jesum a Caipha in prætorium.
Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas into the praetorium.
et ipsi non introierunt in prætorium,
and so they did not enter into the praetorium,
so that they would not be defiled,
Exivit ergo Pilatus ad eos foras,
Therefore, Pilate went outside to them,
Quam accusationem affertis adversus hominem hunc?
“What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
we would not have handed him over to you.”
et secundum legem vestram judicate eum.
“Take him yourselves and judge him according to your own law.”
Then the Jews said to him,
“It is not lawful for us to execute anyone.”
Ut sermo Jesu impleretur, quem dixit,
This was so that the word of Jesus would be fulfilled,
which he spoke signifying what kind of death he would die.
Introivit ergo iterum in prætorium Pilatus:
Then Pilate entered the praetorium again,
“You are the king of the Jews?”
an alii dixerunt tibi de me?
or have others spoken to you about me?”
gens tua et pontifices tradiderunt te mihi:
Your own nation and the high priests have handed you over to me.
Regnum meum non est de hoc mundo.
“My kingdom is not of this world.
Si ex hoc mundo esset regnum meum,
If my kingdom were of this world,
ministri mei utique decertarent ut non traderer Judæis:
my ministers would certainly strive so that I would not be handed over to the Jews.
nunc autem regnum meum non est hinc.
But my kingdom is not now from here.”
And so Pilate said to him,
Tu dicis quia rex sum ego.
“You are saying that I am a king.
et ad hoc veni in mundum,
and for this I came into the world:
so that I may offer testimony to the truth.
Everyone who is of the truth hears my voice.”
And when he had said this,
he went out again to the Jews,
Ego nullam invenio in eo causam.
Est autem consuetudo vobis ut unum dimittam vobis in Pascha:
But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore,
vultis ergo dimittam vobis regem Judæorum?
do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?”
